map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. Your colleagues learn from every crash; Certification awaits the dummy who keeps finding new ones.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Move and walk into the red car's path.
tiles.tale: Dummy Corporation welcomes you. Your colleague has learned nothing yet. Walk into its path; the LED wall applauds.
tiles.hint: Walk into the red car's lane under the highway.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: Dash (Space); after one hit, the car brakes for you in its lane.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 arrives by drone. The sedan now brakes for dummies ahead. Dash in from beside it, under the skybridge.
tiles.hint: Wait beside the lane by the podium; Space as it passes.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors close the flank; drop onto it through a deck gap.
tiles.tale: Side sensors now watch the kerb. Nothing watches upward. Step off the Z2 highway onto a roof; gravity is policy.
tiles.hint: Ride the Z2 escalator; walk through the parapet gap as it nears.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar sees the deck; spring from behind the tower instead.
tiles.tale: The lidar now sees the highway deck. Wait behind the portal tower and let the road come to you.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the portal tower; spring as it passes.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras watch some cover; find the column they miss.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Cameras now report you. Find cover they miss.
tiles.hint: Circle the monument; hide by a column no camera faces; step out.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Hands 1: place a cone (J) to bait the car.
tiles.tale: Hands 1 is on the shelf. The arcade glows; the traffic reads it. Place a cone and sprint in.
tiles.hint: Put a cone (J) in its lane by the arcade; sprint in.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: DUCK (hold C): ambush it from behind a roadside planter.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Be patient: crouch low, wait, then strike the passing car.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the planter by the corner cut; spring.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Jump (L) into the car; it remembers spots, so vary them.
tiles.tale: Legs 1 is bolted on. The canyon walls advertise to each other; jump into a car between them.
tiles.hint: Jump (L) from beside the car as it crosses the canyon.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: White cars tailgate it; make it stop hard for an Incident.
tiles.tale: The fleet tailgates the red car under the gateway. Stop it hard and the car behind files the report.
tiles.hint: Step into its lane by the gateway when a white car follows.

rationale: Tile 4 now teaches springs only, since lidar closes drops. Tile 5 asks one hit, and its arbitrary camera range is gone. Tile 7 is a plain planter ambush. Tile 8 teaches only the jump, count 2. Tile 3's purposeless override is removed. The finale asks one Incident with a tighter tailgate. Tale vocabulary varied.
